opening.argument: The speaker actively promotes recruiting people into a OneCoin affiliate network. Viewers are directed to distribute a sponsor invite link, use a lead-capture funnel, collect prospect information for repeated follow-up messaging, and set the placement of new members within the network. Recruitment-linked dashboard metrics, including bonus earnings and sponsored members, reinforce that purpose. These instructions make recruitment the central activity: the video solicits participation in a network-based earning scheme rather than merely explaining an account. That combination supports finding a recruitment-based scam.
